# GBP/USD (GBPUSD=X) research brief: close on 2026-09-03

I could not open any pages directly because the proxy refused every fetch, including Yahoo Finance. All the figures below come from search-result summaries of secondary FX sites, which disagree by up to about 20 pips, so treat them as approximate. Some results included data dated after 2026-08-20; I ignored it.

## 1. Resolution source
- Resolution uses the Yahoo Finance daily close of GBPUSD=X for 2026-09-03, a Thursday and a normal trading day. My fetch of the Yahoo history page failed, so I can't report the latest value shown there.
- 2026-08-20: one history table lists GBP/USD at about 1.3644, with a range of 1.3595 to 1.3658. A second source gives a mid rate of about 1.3627 and a high of 1.3659. These may include trading after the 18:00 UTC forecast close. [poundsterlinglive](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/GBP-USD-2026), [exchangerates.org.uk](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/GBP-USD-spot-exchange-rates-history-2026.html)
- Yahoo's GBPUSD=X close usually tracks these feeds closely but can differ by a few pips because of timestamp conventions.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Spot is about 1.36, near the middle of the 1.30 to 1.40 question range, with 10 trading days left before resolution.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-20: GBP/USD broke above 1.36, its strongest level since May according to the report. The move was put down to a US Treasury announcement that pushed 10 and 30-year yields lower. [exchangerates.org.uk](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/46912/2026-08-20-pound-to-dollar-price-forecast-gbp-breaks-1-36-as-treasury-move-hits-usd.html)
- 2026-08-19: UK July CPI rose to 2.9% from 2.6%, in line with expectations. Core CPI held at 2.6% and services inflation eased to 3.4%. The pound edged up to about 1.3552 after the release, then rallied to about 1.3624 (+0.65%) after the US Treasury doubled the size of some long-dated buybacks. It closed around 1.3600 (high about 1.3629, low about 1.3524). [exchangerates.org.uk news](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/46905/2026-08-19-pound-sterling-rates-steady-as-uk-inflation-rises-to-2-9.html), [FX Daily Briefing](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/46906/2026-08-19-fx-daily-briefing-pound-sterling-outlook-after-uk-inflation-and-us-yield-drop.html)
- 2026-08-10: IG commentary covered GBP/USD after both central banks held rates; the summary said sterling was mostly following the US dollar. [IG](https://www.ig.com/uk/trading-strategies/gbp-usd-forecast-fed-boe-hold-260810)
- 2026-08-04: the pair was about 1.3433 in early August. [poundsterlinglive](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/GBP-USD-2026)
- 2026-07-30: the Bank of England held Bank Rate at 3.75% on a 6 to 3 vote, with three members wanting a rise. [IG](https://www.ig.com/uk/trading-strategies/gbp-usd-forecast-fed-boe-hold-260810)
- 2026-07-29: the Fed held its range at 3.50% to 3.75%, with three dissenters favouring a hike. [IG](https://www.ig.com/uk/trading-strategies/gbp-usd-forecast-fed-boe-hold-260810)

## 4. Base rates and recent values
- 2026 to date: high about 1.3867 (27 Jan; another feed says 1.3823), low about 1.3141 (24 Jun; another feed says 1.3165), average about 1.344. [poundsterlinglive](https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/GBP-USD-2026), [valutafx](https://www.valutafx.com/history/gbp-usd-2026-07-23)
- Trend: the pair was about 1.32 in late June, rallied after weak US June payrolls (+57k against roughly 110k expected), was about 1.343 on 10 July, closed 31 July at about 1.3482, then rose to about 1.36 by 19 and 20 August. That is roughly +4% from the June low. [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/gbp-usd-forecast/)
- Typical variation, my own estimate rather than a sourced figure: if GBP/USD volatility is about 6% to 8% a year, 10 trading days gives a one standard deviation move of about 1.2% to 1.6%, or roughly ±0.016 to ±0.022. From about 1.36, that is a one sigma range of about 1.34 to 1.38, and reaching 1.30 or 1.40 would take a move of about 2.5 to 4 sigma.
- In 2026 the pair's monthly ranges have often been 2 to 3 big figures (0.02 to 0.03), for example about 1.343 to 1.36 within the first three weeks of August.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Robinhood lists date-specific GBP/USD prediction markets (for example one for 20 August 2026), which suggests a Kalshi-style contract for 3 September may exist. I could not read any prices. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/fx/events/pound-sterling-to-us-dollar-exchange-rate-august-20-2026-aug-20-2026/)
- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this question.
- J.P. Morgan was reported as expecting GBP/USD around 1.31 by September and 1.28 by December. This is a medium-term call, and its date is unclear. [Plus500](https://us.plus500.com/en/forecasts/gbp-usd-forecast-pound-dollar-prediction)
- Other forecast pages: [Cambridge Currencies](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/gbp-usd-forecast/), [NAGA](https://naga.com/en/news-and-analysis/articles/british-pound-gbp-price-prediction), [J2T](https://j2t.com/solutions/blogview/gbp-forecast/).

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-03
- 2026-08-21 (approx.): UK and US flash PMIs and UK retail sales. These are typical calendar slots; I did not confirm the dates.
- 2026-08-27 to 29: Jackson Hole symposium, with a Fed Chair speech as the main dollar risk. This matters because the Fed's July hawkish dissents raise the stakes. [Cambridge Currencies weekly](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-24-august-2026/), [Pound Dynamics](https://pounddynamics.co.uk/pound-sterling/pound-sterling-to-dollar-forecast-gbp-stalls-ahead-of-jackson-hole/)
- Late August: US PCE inflation and the second estimate of Q2 GDP. [Cambridge Currencies weekly](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/weekly-currency-forecast-24-august-2026/)
- 2026-08-31: UK summer bank holiday, so London liquidity will be thin.
- 2026-09-01 to 03: US ISM manufacturing, JOLTS, ADP and ISM services. These are typical slots, not confirmed.
- The US August jobs report (normally the first Friday, likely 2026-09-04) probably comes after resolution, but positioning ahead of it could move the 3 September close.
- More US Treasury buyback or refunding news: the 19 to 20 August rally shows these can move the dollar sharply.
- The next Bank of England decision is in mid-September, after resolution.
